<b>Underscrubs</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are the [[Underworkers|Underworker]] variant of [[Pilgrim Groveller]]s, who wield a coarse steel brush which they use to endlessly clean their domain.<ref>Underscrub Hunter's Journal entry: <i>"Drained yet dedicated labourer, wielding a coarse steel brush."</i></ref><ref>Underscrub Hunter's Journal entry: <i>"That they ever hoped to keep their domain clean... What futility."</i></ref>

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Underscrubs are either stationary and at work or glumly wandering back and forth. Less commonly, they are hiding in rags similarly to [[Drapemite]]s.<br>
When they detect Hornet, they lunge at her with their brush in an attempt to deal contact damage, sliding briefly on the ground before getting back up.

Underscrubs deal {{Damage|1}} on contact.

=== Act 3 ===
[[Black-Threading|Black-threaded]] Underscrubs have their health doubled. They can gain any of the standard [[Black-Threading#Movesets|void attacks]].

== [[Needolin]] Dialogue ==
{{SS Needolin|columns=2|
* For the light, unseen...
* These halls kept clean...
* Rest and fade...
* We... were chosen...
* See us faithful!
* Shells bend, shells break...
* Through duty, purity...
* The sacred toil...
}}

== Location ==
Underscrubs can be found throughout the [[Underworks]], with one fought as part of the [[Enemy Gauntlets (Silksong)/Underworks 2|enemy gauntlet]] in the middle of the area, and another during the [[Enemy Gauntlets (Silksong)/Underworks 3|gauntlet]] in [[the Cauldron]].
